verdicts.evidence: Claim holds against the invariant as written. ARCH.md:15-19: '`app/lib/design_system/` is the single source of colour, type, spacing, radius and size tokens ... Screens import `design_system.dart` and must not hardcode colours or font sizes.' The new block, order_ticket.dart:986-994 (added by this branch per `git diff main...HEAD`), reads `padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10)` and `style: VistaType.body.copyWith(fontSize: 14)`. Context the reviewer did not weigh: `fontSize: 14` already occurs 9 times in this file on main (10 now) and `row()` at :909-918 uses the identical pair of literals, so the new line duplicates a literal rather than inventing one; VistaType has no 14 pt token (scale is 36/20/17/15/13/12/11/10, vista_typography.dart) and adding one is a design-system change beyond this unit; VistaSpace.lg == 10 exists (vista_metrics.dart:7) and design_system.dart exports vista_metrics.dart (:20), with order_ticket.dart already importing design_system.dart (:8). The smallest edit that fits the finding's own first option: hoist the 14 pt style once and share it with row() and the copy line, and spell the 10 px gap as VistaSpace.lg in both places. The remaining single `fontSize: 14` literal is the carried-forward pattern of this file, not new to this run.
